description:
Get comprehensive drug information including properties and clinical phase.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table drug_molecule — one record = one ChEMBL molecule (a parent compound or one of its salt forms).
Key: id.
Arguments: drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.molecule` counts molecules; `_vbt.grains.parent_molecule` counts parent_molecules.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL molecules integrated by OT 25.09 (existence only).

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
